figurative_meaning_en: To raise one's hand to strike or beat someone
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে কখনো তার স্ত্রীর উপর হাত তুলেনি।
শিক্ষক ছাত্রের উপর হাত তোলার চেষ্টা করলেন না।
example_sentences_in_english: He never raised his hand against his wife.
The teacher did not raise his hand to the student.
note: This idiom reflects cultural norms against physical violence in relationships.
